goal: Prevent leaking RPC cookie credentials to foreign local processes when the default IPv4 port is occupied
Require IPv4 loopback bind to succeed so bitcoin-cli does not send auth credentials to an untrusted listener
reviewability: Author is investigating fallback logic for IPv6-only hosts following review suggestions
agreement: Strong support because it closes a local credential leak vulnerability (janb84, winterrdog)
Verified and tested across Debian x86_64 and multiple bind configurations (winterrdog, janb84)
Resolved earlier objection on IPv6 scope ID handling during endpoint deduplication (l0rinc)
Suggested functional tests for remaining coverage gaps and adding a release note (janb84)

categories.name: rpc
why: P1 because it prevents local credential disclosure when another process squats on the IPv4 RPC port
Without this check, an attacker can capture the cookie file and take control of bitcoind over IPv6
